name: Idols NFT
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 0.99). Replaced keyword guess "accounting-math".
rootCause: The Idols NFT contract was exploited on January 14, 2025, for roughly $340,000 in stETH due to flawed accounting in self-transfer logic. The attacker repeatedly self-transferred their NFT, resetting claimed rewards and allowing multiple inflated stETH payouts. The vulnerable _beforeTokenTransfer function failed to distinguish between a true token transfer and a self-transfer, resulting in the reset of claimedSnapshots and enabling repeated reward claims from a single NFT.
